meta.title: MAULT: Automated Trading Card Sorter and Scanner
meta.description: Scan and sort Magic: The Gathering and other trading cards automatically. Build an open-source card sorter, set bin rules, and track your collection's value.

supportedGames.heading: Easily sorts any TCG you love

features.heading: Everything you need to feel organized
features.subtitle: Let Mault handle the sorting, so you can spend more time playing and less time digging through boxes.

recognition.title: Instant recognition
recognition.description: No typing card names, no barcodes. The feeder puts each card in front of the camera, and Mault knows exactly what it is.

rules.title: Rules you control
rules.description: Mix and match conditions, rarity, color, set, type, and more, to send every card exactly where you'd like.

autoAssign.title: Auto bin assignment
autoAssign.description: Skip the rule-writing. Pick a field like rarity or set, and the first card with a new value claims the next open bin. Repeats route back automatically.

repack.title: Build repacks
repack.description: Define pack slots per bin, like 3 commons and 1 rare, and every bin fills its own pack at the same time. Empty it to start the next one.

alphabet.title: Alphabetical sorting
alphabet.description: Sort a pile A to Z, one letter per bin. Then drill into any pile, A into AA, AB, AC, until every card is in order.

sounds.title: Custom sounds
sounds.description: Upload your own clips and play them when a matching card is sorted, like a fanfare for every mythic or a cha-ching for anything over $20.

insights.title: Know what you own
insights.description: See counts, value, cost basis and margins across your whole library, with daily value history, so you never have to guess what the box is worth.

hardware.title: Built for the table
hardware.description: Pairs with a physical sorter, so your cards land in real bins, not just another spreadsheet. Add more sorting modules any time to grow up to 11 bins.

storage.title: Know which box every card is in
storage.description: When a bin is full, empty it into a storage box and Mault records each card's exact position in the stack. Search every box by name, see what each one is worth, and export a box as CSV.

intake.title: Buy collections over the counter
intake.description: Scan a customer's cards into their own intake and watch a cash and store credit offer build from your buylist tiers. Cards below your minimum are struck out, and accepting records what you paid and prints a receipt.

picks.title: Pick online orders from your boxes
picks.description: Paste a TCGplayer pull sheet, a Shopify export or a plain list. Mault finds each card and tells you which box and position it is in, then takes the picked cards out of your inventory.

pickList.title: Pull cards from a decklist
pickList.description: Paste a decklist into any bin and Mault pulls those cards out of the pile as they're scanned, crossing each one off until the list is complete. Everything else sorts as usual.

pricing.title: Prices from three markets
pricing.description: Value your collection with TCGplayer, Cardmarket or Card Kingdom prices, refreshed daily. Set each card's condition and its price adjusts to match.

chaos.title: Chaos sort
chaos.description: Fill bins in order, no rules needed, then empty each one into a box when it's full.

overflow.title: Overflow bins
overflow.description: When a bin fills up or hits its copy limit, the next card spills into the bin you pick.

monitor.title: Watch from your phone
monitor.description: Follow a scan session live from anywhere, or share a read-only link with a friend.

discord.title: Discord alerts
discord.description: Post every scan, or only the cards that match your rules, to your server and ping a role.

stations.title: Several sorters at once
stations.description: Run more than one sorter from a single browser tab, each with its own camera and collection.

ocr.title: Reads the card text
ocr.description: When two printings look alike, Mault reads the name, set and number to tell them apart.

languages.title: Every language
languages.description: Scan cards in other languages, or mix them all in one collection.

api.title: API and webhooks
api.description: Connect your shop: look up where any card is stored and get notified as cards are scanned.

accuracy.title: Spot checks
accuracy.description: Check a random sample of a batch and get an accuracy estimate with a 95% range before you list it.

staff.title: Staff activity
staff.description: See scans and corrections per person, and a log of who changed what.

fleet.title: Sorter alerts
fleet.description: Get told on Discord or by webhook when a sorter jams, goes offline or is due for service.

permissions.title: Buy prices stay private
permissions.description: Let staff scan intakes without seeing offers, costs or margins.

openSource.heading: Fully open source
openSource.subtitle: The software and the physical sorter are both free to build, inspect, and tinker with. Grab the code and print one of your own.

sourceCode.title: Source code
sourceCode.description: The web app, API, and sorter firmware all live together in one repo, under an open license.

printableSorter.title: 3D printable sorter
printableSorter.description: Print your own card sorter at home. Fusion 360 and 3MF files are right there in the repo.

community.title: Community
community.description: Join the Discord to share your build, get a hand when you need it, and chat with others running their own sorter.

pricing.heading: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: The same app either way. Free covers casual sorting. Business removes the daily scan cap, runs several sorters at once, unlocks unlimited custom sounds and Discord notification rules, and adds storage, API access and tools for running a shop.

free.name: Free
free.scanLimit: Up to {{limit}} card scans per day

business.name: Business
business.sorters_one: Up to {{count}} sorter at once, from one browser
business.sorters_other: Up to {{count}} sorters at once, from one browser
business.soundRules: Unlimited sound rules with your own uploaded clips
business.notificationRules: Unlimited Discord notification rules, each posting matching cards to its own channel
business.chaosSort: Chaos sort, the fastest way to put away a big pile
business.storage: Storage locations: record which box every card is in and where, then search across them
business.apiAccess: API access: let your online shop look up which box and position every card is in when picking orders
business.businessTools: Shop tools: buy collections with live buylist offers and receipts, pick online orders from your boxes, and track cost basis and margins

cta.heading: Let's get your cards sorted.
cta.subtitle: Set up your first collection in just a few minutes, and let Mault keep everything organized from here on out.
